targets.name: The Gateposts
targets.brief: Two matching posts either side of a gap, capped in yellow.

targets.name: Founder's Hut
targets.brief: A four-wall hut with a doorway, one window, and a red roof that steps in twice.

targets.name: Signal Tower
targets.brief: A stepped tower that narrows as it rises, with a lamp at the top.

targets.name: Stone Span
targets.brief: Two grey piers stepped in white, carrying a deck with brown railings and a lamp at each end.

targets.name: Halt & Canopy
targets.brief: A platform under a canopy on four columns, with a bench and a lamp.
